## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix

## Testing

- [ ] `make check` passes (ruff, basedpyright, pytest with coverage, bandit, pip-audit)
- [ ] `make pre-commit` passes
- [ ] `make docs` passes if docs changed
- [ ] New behavior has tests that trace to a requirement

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title
- [ ] Commits are signed
- [ ] No em-dashes, no suppressions without an explanation
- [ ] `uv.lock` committed with any dependency change
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated where relevant
